newsitem.title: USA: Burnham sees '97 market comparable to '96.
newsitem.headline: Burnham sees '97 market comparable to '96.

text.p: Burnham Corp said Thursday it expects market conditions for boilers, radiators and related equipment to be much the same this year as last year.
A relatively mild winter has had a early dampening effect on demand, it said, but high consumer confidence and an improving housing market in the Northeast will offset this.
At the same time, the company said it has several new product introductions slated for 1997 that should spur its continued growth.
Burnham issued the comment as it reported record high net income for 1996 of $8.8 million.
Burnham is a manufacturer of boilers, radiators and related equipment for domestic and international residential, industrial and commercial markets.
